Method of Attack: Clipboard stealer that monitors Windows clipboard for cryptocurrency wallet addresses and replaces them with attacker-controlled addresses that closely resemble the victim's intended recipient address
Uses pre-generated similar wallet addresses to deceive users
Supports wallet address generation for multiple cryptocurrencies
Operators can monitor and control attacks via a web-based panel
Real-time notifications via Telegram for clipper actions
Attack Vector: Distributed through Smoke Loader and Raccoon Stealer 2.0 malware
Indicators of Compromise: Clipboard address replaced with attacker’s similar cryptocurrency wallet address
Telegram notifications for stolen funds and clipper activity
